submitted.rationale: With only 3 merit measurements, I measured only compositions with about equal Bi and V, where monoclinic BiVO4 (the known active photoanode phase) should form, and varied the Fe content. Index 72 (Bi0.39 Fe0.24 V0.37) had the highest photocurrent: 5.99 µA. It sits between the two other measured points in Fe content and was also in the GP-UCB top 5.

rejected.reason: Measured 5.14 µA, lower than index 72. Bi≈V with the least Fe tested (0.16).
Measured 4.89 µA, lower than index 72. Bi≈V with the most Fe tested (0.31).
The GP's top pick, but its predicted mean was lower than index 72's. It is V-rich compared with Bi:V = 1:1.
